facts.text: The hotel is on the North Bund in Shanghai, with river views.
facts.excerpt: W Shanghai - The Bund is a luxury hotel with a river view located on the up-and-coming North Bund in glamorous Shanghai.

facts.text: The hotel stands where the city's first cinema made its debut.
facts.excerpt: Where the city’s first cinema made its debut

facts.text: The hotel's style draws on haipai, the local fusion of old with new and East with West.
facts.excerpt: exuding mesmerizing haipai, the uniquely local fusion of old with the new, the east with the west

facts.text: The hotel's look mixes 1920s glam with futuristic flash.
facts.excerpt: our alluring Shanghai dream where 1920s glam and futuristic flash play out

facts.text: Rooms look out on a Huangpu River panorama, with modern decor inspired by old Shanghai.
facts.excerpt: Look out onto a Huangpu River panorama and kick back with modern décor inspired by elements of old Shanghai.

facts.text: The Extreme WOW Suite is a double-decker suite overlooking The Bund.
facts.excerpt: Book our double-decker Extreme WOW Suite overlooking The Bund

facts.text: The Indoor WET pool has oversized whirlpools.

facts.excerpt: Surrounded by soothing settings in a bi-level sanctuary, our spa with city views
Yes, AWAY® Spa is located on-site at W Shanghai - The Bund.

facts.text: WOOBAR is a social bar that works as a cabaret, daytime playground, music bar or cozy studio.
facts.excerpt: Come alive at WOOBAR®, where life is a cabaret, a daytime playground, a music bar, a cozy studio

facts.text: Liquid offers relaxed drinks with sweeping views of the Pudong skyline.
facts.excerpt: Liquid provides an elegant setting for relaxed drinks and sweeping views of the Pudong skyline

facts.text: The Kitchen Table is a New York-style bistro with Bund views serving grilled meats and seafood from the Josper.

facts.text: YEN serves contemporary Jiangnan and Cantonese cuisine with some Shanghainese favorites.
facts.excerpt: YEN celebrates contemporary Jiangnan and Cantonese cuisine mixed in with some Shanghainese favorites.

facts.text: Nearby attractions include the Shanghai Ocean Aquarium, the Oriental Pearl TV Tower and Shanghai Circus World.
facts.excerpt: The Stage, Shanghai Ocean Aquarium, Shanghai New International Expo Center, Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Shanghai Circus World and more are nearby W Shanghai - The Bund.
